name: Royal Mountbattan (1-63-3)
notes: Dates hybridizing code, explained by Dates himself: "The First number designates the first seed planted of crosses harvested in that year. In other words 1-57 means of all the crosses harvested in 1957 this was the first seed pod planted. The second would be 2-57 and so on. name: S. Velutina
